7.brief: Operator, today you will access the farthest and most powerful servers of your consciousness. You engage these systems daily when you gaze at distant clouds or faraway leaves. These distant points in your awareness provide maximum processing speed for compiling complex reality events.
truths: The World develops in your image and according to the merit of your deeds in alignment with The Universe's Will.
When you wish to change the World through your actions, program your deeds for the general good.
Deeds intended for universal benefit create stable reality constructs, improve your core vitality, and achieve collective harmony.
The general good is the ultimate code that leads you to the state of universal and individual life, eternally and forever.
